TAGRA Trucker – Tachograph Software for Professional Drivers

Tachograph software for professional drivers. Driver card download with a standard USB card reader. Evaluation and archiving of driver card data, EU drivers' hours (Regulation 561/2006), breaks and rest periods. Free 30-day trial. Ready for van drivers from July 2026.
Truck Data Technology, s.r.o.
Annual licence fee from year 2. First year included in purchase price.
Who is TAGRA Trucker designed for?

TAGRA Trucker is tachograph software for professional drivers — truck and van drivers — who want to keep track of their own driver card data and monitor compliance with EU drivers' hours and rest periods.
Do I need a USB card reader?

Yes. TAGRA Trucker reads your driver card through a standard USB card reader. If you do not have one, contact us and we will recommend a compatible model — or we can send you one, with price and shipping quoted for your country.
How do I get data into the software?
Connect your USB reader, insert your card, and TAGRA performs the driver card download automatically. You can also import .DDD or .C1B files you've already downloaded elsewhere.
How often should I download my card?

Under EU law, the legal duty to download tachograph data rests on the transport undertaking (Regulation (EU) No 165/2014, Article 33), not the driver. The maximum intervals are at least every 28 days for the driver card and at least every 90 days for the vehicle unit (Commission Regulation (EU) No 581/2010). As an employed driver, the obligation is on your employer — but downloading your own card with TAGRA Trucker still helps you stay on top of your driver's hours and keep personal records. As a self-employed driver or owner-operator, you are the transport undertaking, so the obligation falls on you in that role — and you need a solution that handles both driver card and vehicle unit downloads. In that case, TAGRA 1 is the minimum tier; TAGRA Trucker alone covers only the driver card.
Does TAGRA Trucker work offline?
Yes. TAGRA Trucker works fully offline. Internet is only needed to download the installer and receive updates.
Is TAGRA Trucker ready for the July 2026 van obligation?
Yes. TAGRA Trucker is fully prepared for van drivers (2.5–3.5 t vehicles in international transport) affected by the new tachograph obligation from July 2026.
How do I buy TAGRA Trucker after the trial?
At the end of the trial — or whenever you're ready — open the licence menu inside the software, select TAGRA Trucker and pay online by QR code or bank transfer. Your licence is activated immediately.
